dedupe_keys.name: nepal flood forecasting portal hydrology gov np real time river and rainfall watch flood bulletins and hazard maps

description: The Government of Nepal's flood forecasting portal at hydrology.gov.np has menus for real-time data by basin, river watch, rainfall watch, current forecast, a flood hazard map, community outreach, projects and publications. On 27 September 2026 it listed daily flood bulletins at 8 AM, including special flood bulletins from 23 to 27 September 2026, and river stations with current levels such as Trishuli River at Kali Khola and at Bhorle and Kothi River at Lavani. The portal links to a data request page of the Department of Hydrology and Meteorology and to press releases on multi-hazard early warning by SMS. Coverage is river and rainfall stations across Nepal. Access is online and free for current values and bulletins; archived data are requested from the department. Caveats: the portal is a JavaScript application, bulletins are documents, and historical series are not offered as downloads on the portal. Simulation uses: real-time river levels and flood bulletins for flood warning and exposure of riverside infrastructure. Related records: Malaysia InfoBanjir (data-malaysia-public-infobanjir-water-levels) and ThaiWater (data-thaiwater-national-hydroinformatics-data-center).
